header.name: Oliver Kaikane Gate
header.tagline: Senior full-stack developer with seven years building production software. I work mostly in React and TypeScript, with Python and Node.js behind the UI. I owned the main analytics dashboard at OpenSC and led a five-person frontend team at Redington.

paragraphs: I build interfaces and the services behind them, translating complex domain requirements into tools people can use. My background in Philosophy of Technology informs how I question requirements and explain technical decisions.

experienceOverview: Seven years building production software across supply-chain analytics and financial research. Owned the main analytics dashboard at OpenSC; joined Redington as a junior and progressed to leading a five-person frontend team within two years.

roles.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
roles.summary: Supply-chain traceability venture co-founded by WWF and BCG. Built tools for Nespresso, Austral Fisheries and internal teams to investigate sourcing, provenance and farmer payments.

bullets.text: Owned the main analytics dashboard as its sole engineer, from implementation through maintenance: Python and Plotly Dash for analysis, with React and Next.js for consumer-facing pages.
Built traceability and payment validation used by Nespresso to check coffee sourcing and farmer payments against Rainforest Alliance and AAA programme requirements.
Modelled supply-chain relationships so untraced coffee, capacity breaches and unexpected stock movements could be investigated through graph queries rather than individual supply-chain spot checks.
Worked with Austral Fisheries to validate the legal provenance of toothfish and prawn catches.
Replaced bespoke Dagster orchestration with a YAML-configured ingestion layer and data contracts, allowing new supply chains to be added through configuration.
Built data-entry validation and review flows at the point of capture, supported by monitoring of ingestion accuracy and frequency.

roles.title: Associate Full Stack Developer
roles.summary: UK pensions consultancy. Built the frontend of a multi-tenant investment research platform used by several thousand consultants across seven tenants.

bullets.text: Led frontend architecture decisions for a React and TypeScript dashboard handling sensitive financial data across multiple tenants, with tenant isolation as a core constraint.
Joined as a junior developer and progressed within two years to leading a five-person frontend team responsible for feature delivery.
Introduced Cypress end-to-end testing across the platform to automate release checks and reduce manual release errors.
Led a pro bono discovery workshop for a charity, then migrated its database and supporting infrastructure to Airtable.

leadership: Frontend architecture and five-person team leadership at Redington
Discovery and delivery for a pro bono charity engagement
